• Construction Permits for ENR Upgrade for both the Georges Creek Wastewater Treatment 
Plant and Federalsburg Wastewater Treatment Plant have been issued and these facilities are 
expected to proceed to construction by September 2007. The Georges Creek project is being 
advertised for bids. 
 
• Events 
 
A dedication ceremony for Easton Wastewater Treatment Plant ENR Upgrade was held 
on June 13, 2007 at the Easton Wastewater Treatment Plant.
